name: outdoor/weather/air_temperature
short_desc: outdoor air temperature, on-site 'gund' weather station
long_desc: Outdoor air temperature for on-site 'gund' weather station. Sensor: Siemens 1000 Ω Pt RTD, analog [sensorinfo, "Outdoor Temperature" spec sheet] (accuracy ±0.20–0.25°C across -40–75°C [report, Appendix Table A], range -40 to 75°C [report, Appendix Table A]). Missing-data: Y1 0%, Y2 0%. Two weather stations operate independently (one on the HouseZero roof, one on a nearby building) and their readings are cross-checked [han24, Data Records section]. Sources: [sensorinfo] HZ_Sensors_info.pdf — HouseZero sensor reference manual (Harvard CGBC), spec sheets and floor-plan markers; [report] Data Report.pdf (extras/Data Report/) — per-sensor missing-period tables, Appendix Table A operational accuracy/range, system-sensor notices; [han24] Han et al. 2024, "A two-year dataset of energy, environment, and system operations for an ultra-low energy office building", Sci Data 11:938. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03770-7.

name: outdoor/weather/wind_direction

name: outdoor/weather/rain
short_desc: rainfall, on-site rain gauge
long_desc: Rainfall for on-site rain gauge. Sensor: unknown. Missing-data: Y1 0%, Y2 1.02%.

name: outdoor/weather/humidity
short_desc: outdoor relative humidity, on-site weather station
long_desc: Outdoor relative humidity from the on-site 'gund' weather station. Accuracy ±2.5% from 10–90% RH (typical), up to ±3.5% [report, Appendix Table A]; range 0 to 100% [report, Appendix Table A]. 1 sensor [report, Outdoor Sensors table]. Sparsely populated (most rows empty). Sources: [report] Data Report.pdf (extras/Data Report/).
